Walk into frame: Sirius Symboli (Casual)

I'm just bad at making things awkward, I guess... ahaha...
Sorry, it's pretty uncool of me, huh...

Don't tell me they're about to fight—just as I rush forward to stop them,
I hear a dry laugh.

Come to think of it, from an outsider's perspective, that girl didn't
look troubled at all. Yet Sirius Symboli—

...*Gasp*, haha, ahaha...!
You're right... Yeah, you're totally right...

B-But... it's just scary...
If I do that... and everyone abandons me... I...
The one running—is you. No one else can run your path for you.
A bit late for that.

Though tinged with an air of danger, there is power in her words.
A strength that makes you want to believe in her, follow her—
Better than harboring pathetic regrets.
Hey.

Looking around, I spot many familiar faces among the Umamusume.
For a moment, I wondered if I had walked into the usual place by mistake.
Are you going to ignore your own heart just because of what others say?

Sirius Symboli's words are always straightforward...
And honestly, completely merciless.

Standing before me with that poorly painted smirk plastered on your face.
...It disgusts me.
You lot are everywhere, aren't you?

To begin with, she was sloppy for not hiding it well enough.
I don't care who overheard.
You... follow me.
Wouldn't chasing stray balls suit a little puppy better?

On the way back from an errand that took me a bit further out,
I spotted another branch of our usual pool hall.
Sirius-senpai...
...My admiration is short-lived. She's teasing me.
Huh? Me? Y-Yes?!

So, if you weren't following me, what are you doing here?
You usually hang around the local spot.
—Perhaps that's exactly why.

Should I praise you for finding your way without getting lost?
...Little puppy.

I thought about bringing it up, but...
My friends and parents were all like... "You should just do as you're told," y'know?

Determined not to back down, I put on a resolute face...
Only to be met with her amused, narrowed eyes.

Make your choice.
The will to choose will inevitably strip away everything unnecessary.

Ah... A-Ahaha... Right. Of course.
Nothing gets past you, does it, Sirius-senpai...

Heheh, why not?
Wherever you go, Sirius-senpai, we'll follow!
Anyone... no, Sirius Symboli was the only one who noticed.

U-Um... Sirius-senpai?
What's wrong...? Did I do something...?

I timidly look up, explaining that I hadn't followed her here
nor had I intended to eavesdrop.

I told you. It disgusts me.
Wipe that smile off your face in front of me.

What do you have left after dancing to someone else's tune? Rotten scraps at best.
Listen to me: every single bill eventually comes due to you.

Anyone would notice with a sickening grin like that.
It's obnoxious just having you in my line of sight.

If all you're going to do is blame others for your regrets, choose your own path.
Even if thorns tear into you, take responsibility for it yourself.

Totally! I mean, what are we without you, Senpai?
Forgive us! Haha.

That's just a shackle holding you back.
It's heavy and utterly useless. If they leave on their own, consider it a bargain.

Not everything she says is gentle or easy to accept.
...And yet, strangely enough.

Do as you're told? For what?
Are they going to run in your place? Hell no.
Why waste your breath worrying about people who'd vanish over something so trivial?
Figuring I might as well get some practice in, I step inside, and—
I close my eyes and replay her words in my mind.

No matter how much you missed your master,
to think you'd chase me all the way out here.

Even running as her Trainer instructed, the results never came.
She'd been running with doubts lingering in her mind—or so she said.
